title: Brain Memory
description: Persistent, provenance-stamped memory for AI agents. Deterministic recall over a user's brain (decayed strength, spreading activation, context match), structured memorize with trust-weighted quarantine for low-trust writes, pinning, verification, and bitemporal validity. One brain shared across Claude, Codex, Gemini, Copilot and other agents.
